metadata.patent_title: A method for preparing nitrile rubber with improved heat-oxidative aging …

claims: 1. A method for preparing nitrile rubber with improved thermo-oxidative aging resistance, which is characterized by at least comprising the following steps:

The preparation method comprises the steps of adopting butadiene and acrylonitrile as main polymerization monomers, adopting a reactive type anti-aging agent with amide groups as a functional monomer, taking the total addition amount of the butadiene and the acrylonitrile as 100 parts by mass, adding the acrylonitrile in batches or continuously adding the acrylonitrile, preferably adding the acrylonitrile for more than three times, adopting a low-temperature emulsion polymerization method, adopting a composite emulsifying system, wherein the composite emulsifying agent at least comprises disproportionated rosin acid soap, C

linear alkylbenzene sulfonic acid and naphthalene sulfonic acid formaldehyde condensate sodium salt, preferably adding the composite emulsifying agent in an amount of 3.2-6.5 parts, more preferably 3.8-6.0 parts, adding the molecular weight regulator for one time or multiple times to synthesize nitrile rubber slurry, adding a terminator, and degassing, condensing, washing and drying the nitrile rubber.
2. The preparation method of the nitrile rubber according to claim 1, wherein the composition ratio of the main polymerization monomer is 80-83 parts of butadiene and 17-20 parts of acrylonitrile.

The present invention discloses a method for preparing a nitrile rubber with improved heat-oxidative aging resistance, comprising: using butadiene and acrylonitrile as main polymerization monomers, using a reactive antioxidant with an amide group as a functional monomer; taking the total amount of butadiene and acrylonitrile added as 100 parts by mass, and adding acrylonitrile in batches or continuously, preferably more than three times; using a low-temperature emulsion polymerization method, the composite emulsifier contains at least disproportionated rosin acid soap,

linear alkylbenzene sulfonic acid, and naphthalenesulfonic acid formaldehyde condensate sodium salt; preferably, the composite emulsifier is added in an amount of 3.2-6.5 parts, more preferably 3.8-6.0 parts, a molecular weight regulator is added once or multiple times, a nitrile rubber slurry is synthesized, a terminator is added, and a nitrile rubber is prepared after degassing, coagulation, washing and drying. The present invention produces a nitrile rubber with a combined acrylonitrile content of 17-20% and a Mooney viscosity of 1.5-2.0%.
A nitrile rubber with excellent heat and oxygen aging resistance and a reactive antioxidant combined with 1 to 2% of the compound.
